label.text: With calls on, every new call has its media on the edge node, so office users in a call with each other send it to the cloud and back. There is no cascading to a media node of this node's own, and one local node per edge node takes calls.
Other local nodes are linked to the edge node too, so it takes call messages from none of them until only one is.
This node has no enabled trunk yet. The trunks set up here go to the edge node and register from there.

Outside phones register to the edge node's registrar, which asks this node to check each password, so they cannot register while this node is away. While it is away, a call to a number with a fallback rings its outside number or takes a message, following no call-handling rules or schedules; a number with none is refused (480), so the trunk's own failover can act.
Other local nodes are active on the edge node too, so its SIP engine reads no node's trunks or fallbacks until only one is.
